auth_live.instructions: Do the authentication counts show a live person signing in, rather than only stale failures on an already-disabled account?

criteria.yes: co bang chung dang nhap thanh cong moi cho tai khoan dang hoat dong, va cac su kien co nguoi thao tac
criteria.no: chi co dang nhap that bai lai tren mot tai khoan da bi vo hieu hoa, khong co hoat dong moi
criteria.unknown: thieu log dang nhap hoac thieu thoi diem vo hieu hoa tai khoan de ket luan

off_hours_human.instructions: Do the off-hours counts look like a person acting, rather than directory sync or an unattended service?

criteria.yes: co hoat dong ngoai gio co dau hieu nguoi thao tac va khong giai thich duoc bang dong bo
criteria.no: khong co hoat dong ngoai gio, hoac chi co dong bo thu muc / dich vu khong can nguoi
criteria.unknown: khong co du lieu gio lam viec, danh sach phep lam viec ngoai gio, hoac khong phan biet duoc dong bo

mail_exfil.instructions: Do the external-mail counts and file names look like customer or bank documents sent to a personal mailbox?

criteria.yes: co thu gui ra ngoai den dia chi ca nhan kem tep dinh kem co ten file lien quan khach hang
criteria.no: khong co thu ra ngoai dang ngo, hoac chi co gui noi bo theo quy trinh
criteria.unknown: khong co du lieu nhan tho, khong co danh sach dia chi ca nhan, hoac khong xem duoc ten file dinh kem

file_staging.instructions: Do the file counts look like bulk copy or deletion of work files?

criteria.yes: so luong file doc hoac xoa lớn so voi baseline cua nguoi dung va nam trong mot khoang thoi gian ngan
criteria.no: khong vuot baseline, hoac chi la truy cap thuong ngay
criteria.unknown: khong co baseline cua nguoi dung de so sanh

same_window_chain.instructions: Do authentication, mail, and file signals pile up together in this window, rather than one isolated counter?

criteria.yes: nhieu loai dau hieu xuat hien cung mot khoang thoi gian va cung mot nguoi dung
criteria.no: chi co mot loai dau hieu don le, khong co chuoi hoat dong
criteria.unknown: khong du thoi gian de xac dinh khoang hop nhat cua cac dau hieu

behavior.instructions: Which pattern best fits this profile?

criteria.binh_thuong: ordinary work inside the bank, no personal mailbox and no bulk delete
criteria.dong_bo: directory or mailbox sync, high Entra volume without mail or file actions by a person
criteria.dang_nhap_cu: failures on a disabled account with no successful new activity
criteria.nguoi_thao_tac: a person acting off-hours or after the disable date
criteria.don_du_lieu: deleting or sending files and mail together, including sends to a personal mailbox

severity.instructions: How soon should an analyst open this profile? Bank hard rules already set a floor; this score only ranks the profile and never raises the severity.
criteria: theo doi: no extra review beyond the rule floor
xem trong ngay: open after the hard-rule queue
xem ngay: open together with the hard-rule queue
